newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Cebu export zone eyes container port.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Cebu export zone eyes container port.

text.p: Mactan Export Processing Zone in the central Philippines is planning to reclaim 150 to 200 hectares of land to build a new container port and expand its 212-hectare industrial area, zone administrator Ismael Itaas said on Wednesday.
"We are thinking of reclaiming part of the offshore area here ... Part of the reclaimed area wil be for a container port facility, plus an expansion of the industrial area," he told reporters.
The container port will be exclusively used by companies located inside the special economic zone.
"It is better to have a container port beside the zone and an international airport beside the zone, the movement of cargo will be easier," he said.
The Mactan zone is the third biggest exporter in the country, accounting for about five percent of the country's total export receipts last year.
It hosts about 116 light industries, mostly foreign companies, which employ more than than 32,000 people.
Itaas said the size of the reclamation will depend on a surveyor's report.
Companies inside the zone, on an island off the city of cebu, are eligible for tax and tariff incentives.
The biggest companies inside the zone include TMX Philippines Inc, which makes Timex watches, and National Semiconductors (H.K) Distribution Ltd.
